text:
ana: Heads-up — bringup for quantized-30B (q4f16) on Dedicated. Planning capacity for US-west (H100) + EU-west (A100) pools. Goal: p99 <= 300ms for short prompts (~64 tokens) and sustain 1200 tok/s avg per GPU.
sam: Do we have recent kernel picks for q4f16 on H100 vs A100? last sweep showed faster attention kernel on H100 but A100 favored fused-gemm path.
mika: H100: use cuda_attn_v2 + flash_attn fallback. A100: use cublas_fp16_gemv with optimized matmul kernels. perf delta ~1.25x H100->A100 on our bench for 64-token sequences.
ana: @mika can you paste the numbers? need to convert to GPU counts.
mika: bench-bot: latest run (3123456000) — 30B q4f16, batch=4, seq=64, kv-cache warm: H100 (p99=220ms, avg tok/s=1500), A100 (p99=280ms, avg tok/s=1200). tail events mostly cold-cache.
bench-bot: Note: warmup window measured at ~18k tokens over first 30s.
jordan: For Dedicated sizing we need autoscale headroom for microburst 5x baseline for 90s. If we target sustained 1200 tok/s per GPU, plan for 6000 tok/s per pool headroom.
sam: Can we map to GPUs? example: target global steady traffic 120k tok/s. With H100 perf ~1500 tok/s -> need ~80 GPUs steady. Add 3x microburst headroom -> 240 GPUs peak. That's heavy. maybe we should leverage regional fallback + smaller model for spikes.
ana: Proposal: primary pool = H100 us-west sized for 1.5x average (to reduce autoscale churn), secondary autoscale pool in eu-west (A100) for overflow with lower concurrency target. Also enable model-fallback to 13B-quant for spikes >3x.
mika: Suggest concurrency targets: per GPU concurrency 6 for H100, 5 for A100 (based on latency SLO). Batch config: max_batch_tokens=4096, batch_timeout_ms=10.
jordan: ops concerns: warmup/cache pressure when routing between pools. We should pre-warm KV-cache for canary rollouts and do cross-region cache seeding if we funnel traffic. Otherwise tail latency spikes.
sam: How much capacity for warmup seeding? estimate ~10% additional GPU-hours to keep active cache across a small set of user prefixes.
ana: Action items: 1) run a 1-hour sim with poisson bursts (1x baseline, 5x spikes at 90s) to get realistic autoscale events. 2) quant-kernel sweep on A100 to validate fused path at batch=4/8. 3) draft autoscale policy: min=steady*0.9, target=steady*1.5, burst-capacity=3x with fast scaling (30s step).
mika: I'll queue the sim and kernel sweep on perf cluster. starting job id perf-3123456701.
bench-bot: perf run queued: perf-3123456701. Estimated finish 45m.
jordan: Also add a canary traffic slice that routes 2% of traffic to eu-west early to measure cross-region fallback latency and cost.
sam: cost check: H100 reserved billing vs burst on A100? finance will need numbers. Ana can you flag for finance?
ana: Yup, I'll loop in finance. Also adding note: for SLA we need documented fallback policy and estimated RTO for model downgrade path.
sam: One more thought — consider scheduling warmup pulls during off-peak so caches are hot before expected surge windows. Might reduce peak GPU count.
mika: Agreed. I'll add a warmup cron job that hits common prefixes.
jordan: Ok. If perf sim shows >2x autoscale oscillation we'll tighten scale-in cooldowns and prefer more static reserved for baseline.
ana: Thanks all — will post sim results and a preliminary GPU-count table when perf run completes. :thumbsup:
